title: Experience
subtitle: Eight years across AI, embedded systems, and full-stack development.

items.title: AI Engineer
items.description: Started as a Java Developer leading a sizable team on a demanding client engagement. After six successful months, I was tapped to drive Globant's experimental AI initiatives, building POCs that demonstrated the practical value of generative AI in process automation. I'm now a key technical reference in Italy for AI integration in enterprise automation projects.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Developed firmware and software for integrated seismic and structural monitoring systems. Programmed microcontrollers in C/C++ for power management and data acquisition, and built Python tooling on ObsPy for seismic analysis. Coordinated a 4-person team for a research project funded by the Tuscany Region.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Designed and built application software for an ARM-based touchscreen device. Used C++/Qt/QML for the UI and core logic, OpenCV and GStreamer for image processing, and built a custom Linux distribution with the Yocto Project. Also produced prototype enclosures with a 3D printer.

items.title: Software / Automation Engineer
items.description: Configured hardware and developed software for Siemens and Allen-Bradley PLCs and Fanuc industrial robots (with certification). Reviewed electrical schematics and commissioned automation lines on-site. Built small internal web tools to streamline project management.

items.title: Junior Automation Engineer
items.description: Developed and modified PLC software (Siemens, Allen-Bradley) to control machinery, adapted operator panel UIs to client requirements, and ran electrical and functional testing on completed builds.

items.title: Web Developer
items.description: Worked on a web-based management system for workplace safety. Built server-side logic in Java and client-side behavior in JavaScript on proprietary frameworks, against SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle DB.

items.title: Full-Stack Developer (Part-time)
items.description: Built a small home-PLC product end to end: server side on Java EE / Tomcat with PHP components, and a dynamic jQuery-based front-end making the device easily configurable by end users.
